risk_if_not_implemented: Without Supporting Toolchain, applications may be built and deployed with exploitable design and coding weaknesses that adversaries can leverage. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, no risk is rated Likely; risks rated Possible include Unauthorized Modification / Loss of System Integrity (R-AM-2), Reduced Operational Productivity (R-BC-3), System / Data Compromise (Technical Vector) (R-BC-4), and most likely increases susceptibility to Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10).

compensating_control_1.name: Secure Engineering Principles
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of industry-recognized security, compliance and resilience practices in the specification, design, development, implementation and modification of Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS).
compensating_control_1.justification: Secure Engineering Principles (SEA-05) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Supporting Toolchain (TDA-05.3) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Technology applicability. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Secure Software Development Practices (SSDP)
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to develop applications based on Secure Software Development Practices (SSDP).
compensating_control_2.justification: Secure Software Development Practices (SSDP) (TDA-05) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Supporting Toolchain (TDA-05.3) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Technology applicability. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
